spec.rawSql:
SELECT
	timestamp      AS time,
	technical_name AS name,
	level__value   AS level
FROM public.marpower__thrs__level_sensors
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY technical_name, timestamp DESC

SELECT
	timestamp      AS time,
	technical_name AS name,
	level__value   AS level
FROM public.marpower__tech_water__level_sensors
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY technical_name, timestamp DESC

SELECT
	timestamp             AS time,
	UPPER(technical_name) AS name,
	level__value          AS level
FROM public.marpower__sewage__level_sensors
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
AND technical_name <> 'sludge-level'
ORDER BY technical_name, timestamp DESC

SELECT
  timestamp         AS time,
	TANK_LEVEL__value AS bilge_tank
from marpower__210000_bilge_fifi_general
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC

SELECT
	timestamp      AS time,
	technical_name AS name,
	level__value   AS level
FROM public.marpower__sewage__level_sensors
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
AND technical_name = 'sludge-level'
ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT
	timestamp      AS time,
	level__value   AS sludge
FROM public.marpower__300000_dirty_oil__sludge__sludge_level
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC

WITH g0 AS (
  SELECT
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-level-tank1' THEN v END) AS v1,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-level-tank1' THEN ts END) AS t1,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-level-tank2' THEN v END) AS v2,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-level-tank2' THEN ts END) AS t2
  FROM (
    SELECT technical_name AS k, last_value(level__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS v, max(timestamp) AS ts
    FROM public.marpower__fresh_water__level_sensors
    WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' 
    GROUP BY technical_name
  ) AS x
),
m AS (
  SELECT mqtt_json_path, max(yard_tag) AS yard_tag FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
  WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/250000-fresh-water' GROUP BY mqtt_json_path
)
SELECT s.signal AS "Signal",
  coalesce(m.yard_tag, s.tag) AS "Tag",
  CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN arrow_cast(round(g0.v1, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 2 THEN arrow_cast(round(g0.v2, 2), 'Utf8')
  END AS "State",
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN g0.t1
    WHEN 2 THEN g0.t2
  END) AS "Updated"
FROM (VALUES
  (1, 'Fresh water tank 1 [L]', 'tank_1_fr_45_ps_level', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (2, 'Fresh water tank 2 [L]', 'tank_2_fr_45_sb_level', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'))
) AS s(n, signal, path, tag)
LEFT JOIN g0 ON true
LEFT JOIN m ON m.mqtt_json_path = s.path
ORDER BY s.n

WITH l AS (
  SELECT * FROM public.marpower__210000_bilge_fifi_general
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' 
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
),
m AS (
  SELECT mqtt_json_path, max(yard_tag) AS yard_tag FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
  WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/210000-bilge-fifi-general' GROUP BY mqtt_json_path
)
SELECT s.signal AS "Signal",
  coalesce(m.yard_tag, s.tag) AS "Tag",
  CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN arrow_cast(round(l.tank_level__value, 2), 'Utf8')
  END AS "State",
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(l.timestamp) AS "Updated"
FROM (VALUES
  (1, 'Bilge tank [L]', 'tank_level', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'))
) AS s(n, signal, path, tag)
LEFT JOIN l ON true
LEFT JOIN m ON m.mqtt_json_path = s.path
